map.⚖️ 化工质量管理体系自查: Chemical Industry Quality Management System Self-Check
map.按\"标准管理 / 过程检查 / 整改闭环\"三大模块逐项自查，自动计算各模块达: Self-check item by item across the three modules of standard management, process inspection and rectification closure, automatically computing the attainment rate of each module and the system compliance degree, locating weak links and outputting a rectification list.
map.📖 查看「化工质量管理体系自查 使用指南」: View the Chemical Industry Quality Management System Self-Check User Guide
map.体系合规度 = 各项实得分 ÷ 满分 ×100% ≥90% 优秀，75-89%: System compliance degree = actual score of each item / full score x 100%. 90% and above is excellent, 75-89% is good, 60-74% is pass,
map.体系合规度 = 各项实得分 ÷ 满分 ×100%: System compliance degree = actual score of each item / full score x 100%
map.≥90% 优秀，75-89% 良好，60-74% 合格，<60% 不合格: 90% and above is excellent, 75-89% is good, 60-74% is pass, below 60% is fail
map.本工具参照 ISO 9001 及化工行业质量管理体系要求设计，不替代外部审核: This tool is designed with reference to ISO 9001 and the quality management system requirements of the chemical industry; it does not replace external audit
map.📚 深度解析：化工质量管理体系自查: In-Depth Analysis: Chemical Industry Quality Management System Self-Check
map.ISO 9001 内审准备：按标准条款逐项自查，生成不符合项清单与整改建议，缩短: ISO 9001 internal audit preparation: self-check item by item against the standard clauses, generate a list of nonconformities and rectification suggestions, and shorten the external audit preparation cycle.
map.生产许可审查迎检：对照生产许可与行业规范核查过程控制记录，定位证据缺口。: Production licence review inspection: check process control records against the production licence and industry specifications, and locate evidence gaps.
map.年度体系合规自评：量化各模块达成率与总体合规度，跟踪年度改进成效。: Annual system compliance self-assessment: quantify the attainment rate of each module and the overall compliance degree, and track the results of annual improvement.
map.输入各模块自查结果，工具输出标准管理达成率、过程检查达成率、整改闭环达成率及总体: Entering the self-check results of each module, the tool outputs the attainment rates for standard management, process inspection and rectification closure plus the overall compliance degree, and lists the items that failed as a rectification list.
map.自查结果能直接用于外审吗？: Can the self-check results be used directly for the external audit?
map.可作为内审与迎检准备依据；正式认证仍由具备资质的认证机构实施，并需保留客观证据与: They can serve as the basis for internal audit and inspection preparation; formal certification is still carried out by a qualified certification body, and objective evidence and records must be retained.
map.达成率低如何改进？: How to improve when the attainment rate is low?
map.先定位未达标模块（标准/检查/整改），针对薄弱项补充文件、培训与过程记录，再闭环: First locate the module that failed (standard/inspection/rectification), supplement documents, training and process records for the weak items, then verify closure.
map.与 ISO 9001 条款如何对应？: How does this map to the ISO 9001 clauses?
map.可将 16 项要点映射到标准条款（如文件控制、过程确认、不合格品控制），使自查结: The 16 points can be mapped to standard clauses (such as document control, process confirmation and nonconforming product control), making the self-check results traceable to the system requirements.
